crossrefs.text: so that you may walk in a manner worthy of the Lord and may please Him in every way: bearing fruit in every good work, growing in the knowledge of God,

Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending together as one for the faith of the gospel,
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.
It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.
encouraging you, comforting you, and urging you to walk in a manner worthy of God, who calls you into His own kingdom and glory.
You have ascended on high; You have led captives away. You have received gifts from men, even from the rebellious, that the LORD God may dwell there.
Then I will give you shepherds after My own heart, who will feed you with knowledge and understanding.”
And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.
Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?
built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Christ Jesus Himself as the cornerstone.
He has lost connection to the head, from whom the whole body, supported and knit together by its joints and ligaments, grows as God causes it to grow.
Little children, let us love not in word and speech, but in action and truth.
Do not be carried away by all kinds of strange teachings, for it is good for the heart to be strengthened by grace and not by foods of no value to those devoted to them.

notes.title: When he ascended on high he led captives

crossrefs.text: Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what is the good, pleasing, and perfect will of God.
The mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace,
We know that our old self was crucified with Him so that the body of sin might be rendered powerless, that we should no longer be slaves to sin.
Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me.
and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
and have put on the new self, which is being renewed in knowledge in the image of its Creator.
And over all these virtues put on love, which is the bond of perfect unity.
Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober-minded. Set your hope fully on the grace to be given you at the revelation of Jesus Christ.
Let your speech always be gracious, seasoned with salt, so that you may know how to answer everyone.
Therefore encourage and build one another up, just as you are already doing.
Therefore, as the elect of God, holy and beloved, clothe yourselves with hearts of compassion, kindness, humility, gentleness, and patience.
Bear with one another and forgive any complaint you may have against someone else. Forgive as the Lord forgave you.
The words of a wise manʼs mouth are gracious, but the lips of a fool consume him.
My beloved brothers, understand this: Everyone should be quick to listen, slow to speak, and slow to anger,
Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.
